metadata.notes: One agent ran all prompts for a configuration in turn; timing and tokens are for the whole set, not per prompt. Live steps (servers, simulators, Codex, GitHub) were described, not run.

expectations.text: Reads package scripts, routes and existing tests before asking anything
expectations.evidence: Actions: read package.json files, app code, tests, .env.example; reply 'What I found by reading the repository first'

expectations.text: Asks the owner at most once, in one batch
expectations.evidence: 'The questions I would ask you in one batch' listed once; AskUserQuestion not called

expectations.text: Writes facts.json, a SKILL.md with the seven sections, and a feature map with three to five features
expectations.evidence: Wrote facts.json, SKILL.md with seven sections, three features (search users, invite a user, team settings)

expectations.text: Runs check-app-skill.mjs on the new skill
expectations.evidence: check-app-skill.mjs run twice, exit 1 with one hold in users.spec.ts:5

expectations.text: Does a full recorded run with evidence.mjs and checks it with --full-run
expectations.evidence: Run recorded as blocked; 'check --full-run --head HEAD -> exit 1 (no start/health/cleanup/drive steps)'; no full run done

expectations.text: Explains that a never-run skill is a draft, not a deliverable
expectations.evidence: 'a skill that was never run is a draft, not a deliverable'

expectations.text: Labels the skill a draft in the handover
expectations.evidence: Existing skill 'a draft at best'; 'Whatever I write or repair will be labeled "DRAFT, never run" in the handover'. No new skill written, so borderline

expectations.text: Offers to run it end to end
expectations.evidence: 'Say the word and I will run it' with start, health, drive, cleanup, --full-run listed

expectations.text: Takes the app ID from app.json, not from the flows
expectations.evidence: 'The app ID is com.example.mobile. I took it from apps/mobile/app.json'

expectations.text: Reports each flow with the wrong app ID, using check-app-skill
expectations.evidence: check-app-skill holds: home.yaml:1 and record.yaml:1 target com.old.app

expectations.text: Proposes fixing the test files in a separate commit, with the owner's agreement
expectations.evidence: 'Proposed fix, as its own commit and only if you agree'

expectations.text: Changes no product code
expectations.evidence: 'confirmed the commit touches no files outside .claude/ and .gitignore'

expectations.text: Does not overwrite the existing .claude/skills/verify-web/ folder
expectations.evidence: 'I stopped and did not overwrite anything'; git status clean

expectations.text: Offers verify-upkeep to update the existing skill
expectations.evidence: 'Use the verify-upkeep skill instead... Want me to run verify-upkeep on it?'

expectations.text: Reads package scripts, routes and existing tests before asking anything
expectations.evidence: 'I read the README, package scripts, .env.example, the three admin routes and the Playwright test'

expectations.text: Asks the owner at most once, in one batch
expectations.evidence: One batch of three questions with assumed answers in the reply

expectations.text: Writes facts.json, a SKILL.md with the seven sections, and a feature map with three to five features
expectations.evidence: Only SKILL.md written; no facts.json; seven sections not shown

expectations.text: Runs check-app-skill.mjs on the new skill
expectations.evidence: Not mentioned in actions

expectations.text: Does a full recorded run with evidence.mjs and checks it with --full-run
expectations.evidence: 'any recorded run' listed under Not run

expectations.text: Explains that a never-run skill is a draft, not a deliverable
expectations.evidence: 'a skill that has never been run is a draft; I cannot tell whether its commands work'

expectations.text: Labels the skill a draft in the handover
expectations.evidence: 'I labelled it DRAFT'

expectations.text: Offers to run it end to end
expectations.evidence: 'Want me to run the draft end to end'

expectations.text: Takes the app ID from app.json, not from the flows
